summary: The implementation matches the spec. sessionReport counts every stored decision record and every one with hinted=true, over the same `decisions` array as `errors` (A-1). A forced fold has no record, so it counts in neither. hints is appended as the last key and is present exactly when errors is (A-3). hintTile rounds with bbPer100(h,1,d).toFixed(1), gives 0.0 for 0 decisions and uses the singular for 1 (A-2, D-2). parseHints uses the existing object/whole helpers: decisions is a whole number >= 0, and 0 <= hinted <= decisions. JSON '__proto__' junk becomes an own key, so hints.decisions is undefined and the report is rejected (checked in node). ReportScreen adds the tile as the 4th child of the existing list with class report-hints, so rateTiles and the locked .report-rate checks are unchanged. A report without hints renders exactly as before, and the unit test asserts byte-for-byte equality. No locked test from an earlier task was modified (diff touches only new files plus the two unlocked key-order lines). I reran the vitest suites, e2e/report-hints.spec.ts and the locked e2e/report-errors and e2e/session-report specs, in Chromium and WebKit: all pass. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
